[writeLog](https://github.com/jeffzifanwu/writeLog) is an R package (available on [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=writeLog)) for logging interim results in data and analytical pipelines. Its `writeLog()` function saves results to versioned text files, so users can track how results change across long pipelines when code or data change. This helps with debugging, experimentation and testing.
